target: tracker.sh shelve — TRACKER_FORCE_LIVE=1 overrides the mid-stage refusal
cmd:
mkdir -p factory/specs; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: in-flight
status: building
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; if TRACKER_FORCE_LIVE=1 tracker_shelve factory/specs/001-a.md me 'abandoning the run' >/dev/null 2>&1; then EC=0; else EC=$?; fi; jq -n --argjson ec "$EC" --arg st "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" --arg from "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md shelved_from)" '{ec: $ec, st: $st, from: $from}'
_note: paired with 059 — together they prove the gate actually reads the flag rather than always refusing or always allowing. shelved_from must record `building` so restore puts the spec back mid-pipeline, where a human can decide to re-run the stage.
